policy.levelResolution: Higher and Ordinary reference headings are joined only to the same level in the local SEC corpus; English/Irish editions share the same printed section classification.
policy.granularity: StudyClix may split the compulsory Section A into several headings. NextStepUni retains every factual heading as part-aware metadata while its current official-paper sidecar presents the complete printed Section A as one card.
policy.excludedContent: No commercial mock question, solution, note, question text, StudyClix image or StudyClix-hosted PDF is copied.
